answers.core: Need a way to determine what we seeing. Is it `Callable`? and is it better to call with `await` or without. For now i __can__ check at compile time, but i want to process some functions at runtime. And there are no ways to overcome this crash/error
answers.workaround: By default we can use as in javascript to await for blocking methods as if they would be async. Let's say we want to call it from non-async method. Then `Need to use await` error will arise

title: `Callable.is_async()` - to check run it with `await` or not.
